title: Person: Mr Casey
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Mr Casey

anchor.prefix:
speak with the voice of the hotel keeper.

 —And he has such a soft mouth when he’s speaking to you, don’t you know. He’s very moist and watery about the dewlaps, God bless him.
anchor.suffix:
was still struggling through his fit of coughing and laughter. Stephen, seeing and hearing the hotel keeper through his father’s face and voice, laughed.
